how_to_apply: Go to the official website at https://cochinshipyard.in/ (Career page -> UCSL, Malpe) or www.udupicsl.com (Career page) and read the User Manual and FAQ.
Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal.
Log in and submit the online application between 07 October 2026 and 28 October 2026.
Upload scanned copies of certificates for age, educational qualification, experience, caste, and a recent passport-size colour photograph.
Pay the application fee of ₹ 1,000/- online using Debit card, Credit card, or Internet Banking (SC/ST candidates are exempted).
Submit the application successfully and ensure the status shows "In process".
Take a printout or save a soft copy of the submitted online application containing the unique registration number for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates must ensure they meet eligibility requirements before submitting applications. Applications submitted direct or by any other mode will not be accepted. Applicants working in regular Government service or PSUs must upload a declaration (Annexure-I) and produce a No Objection Certificate before final selection. Ex-servicemen re-employed in Government service must submit an undertaking (Annexure-II). No hard copy of the application or certificates needs to be sent by post to Udupi Cochin Shipyard Ltd. Candidates appearing for Personal Interview are eligible for reimbursement of single to & fro third AC rail fare by the shortest route on production of proof and bank passbook details. content_sections.heading: UCSL Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens. Assistant General Manager (Contract cell): Minimum of 15 years managerial experience in sub-contracting, vendor development, purchasing, operations, or managing government tenders in shipbuilding, ship repair, offshore fabrication, or marine-related engineering companies/establishments. Assistant General Manager (Design): Minimum of 15 years managerial experience in Hull structure Design, Machinery outfit Design, or Hull outfit design of ships in shipbuilding, ship repair, offshore fabrication, or marine-related engineering companies/establishments. Manager (Hull): Minimum of 9 years managerial experience (for Degree holders) or 12 years managerial experience (for Diploma holders) in Hull, Outfitting, Heavy Fabrication, Erection functions in shipbuilding, ship repair, offshore fabrication, or marine-related engineering companies/establishments. Deputy Manager (Quality control): Minimum of 7 years managerial experience (for Degree holders) or 10 years managerial experience (for Diploma holders) in Quality Control of Outfitting, Machinery, Piping, Structural Outfit, or Fabrication functions in shipbuilding, ship repair, offshore fabrication, petrochemical companies, or marine-related companies/establishments. Deputy Manager (Electrical Design): Minimum of 7 years managerial experience (for Degree holders) or 10 years managerial experience (for Diploma holders) in Electrical Design Applications such as AutoCAD, Tribon, Aveva, or CADMATIC in shipbuilding, ship repair, offshore fabrication, petrochemical companies, or marine-related companies/establishments.

Work Experience in the relevant job/area: 40 marks Power Point Presentation on work experience: 30 marks Group Discussion: 10 marks Personal Interview: 20 marks Total: 100 Marks Candidates provisionally shortlisted must deliver a PowerPoint Presentation (not exceeding 10 minutes) highlighting their work experience. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UCSL Recruitment
content_sections.text: Go to the official website at https://cochinshipyard.in/ (Career page -> UCSL, Malpe) or www.udupicsl.com (Career page) and read the User Manual and FAQ. Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal. Log in and submit the online application between 07 October 2026 and 28 October 2026. Upload scanned copies of certificates for age, educational qualification, experience, caste, and a recent passport-size colour photograph. Pay the application fee of ₹ 1,000/- online using Debit card, Credit card, or Internet Banking (SC/ST candidates are exempted). Submit the application successfully and ensure the status shows "In process". Take a printout or save a soft copy of the submitted online application containing the unique registration number for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of age (Birth certificate / SSLC certificate) Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificates indicating date of joining and relieving (or Offer letter, latest Pay Slip, and CTC certificate / IT Form-16 for current employment) Caste certificate (for SC candidates in the prescribed format issued by Tahsildar) NDT Level 2 or ASNT Level 2 certificate (for Deputy Manager Quality Control) Discharge Certificate / Book / Pension Payment Order (for Ex-servicemen) Recent passport-size colour photograph

faq.question: Q1. What is UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UCSL Recruitment 2026 is an official notification issued by Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited to fill 5 regular roll Executive posts including Assistant General Manager, Manager, and Deputy Manager.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 regular roll vacancies are available across Assistant General Manager (Contract cell), Assistant General Manager (Design), Manager (Hull), Deputy Manager (Electrical Design), and Deputy Manager (Quality control).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for UCSL Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant General Manager posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Degree in Mechanical, Production, Electrical, Electronics, Civil, or Marine Engineering (or Naval Architecture for Design post) with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized University, along with required managerial experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Manager posts in UCSL?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the post of Manager is 40 years as on 28 October 2026 (applicants should be born on or after 29 October 1986).

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for UCSL Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is ₹ 1,000/- for General and other candidates. SC and ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for UCSL Executive posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the SAP Online portal accessible via the official website www.cochinshipyard.in or www.udupicsl.com between 7 October 2026 and 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UCSL Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a PowerPoint Presentation on work experience (worth 30 marks), relevant work experience assessment (40 marks), Group Discussion (10 marks), and Personal Interview (20 marks).
